svg.title: Equal-loudness curves
svg.desc: Sound intensity level in decibels versus frequency on a logarithmic scale from 20 Hz to 20 000 Hz, with thirteen equal-loudness curves from 0 to 120 phons in steps of 10. Every sound on one curve seems equally loud. At 1000 Hz each curve passes through the decibel value equal to its phon number. The curves dip lowest near 3000 to 4000 Hz, where the ear is most sensitive, and rise steeply at low frequencies; the 0-phon curve, the threshold of hearing, is about 37 dB at 100 Hz and about −7 dB near 3500 Hz. The curves flatten out at high loudness.
